title: Divide, Evaluate, and Refine: Evaluating and Improving Text-to-Image Alignment with Iterative VQA Feedback
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and improving text-to-image alignment. It introduces a new benchmark dataset (Decomposable-Captions-4k) and utilizes large language models for prompt decomposition. There is no component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
